procedure: Each item is fixed as written before any repository script for it exists. The C1 script is tested on synthetic data, then run once on the development tables. Values that differ from the expected values are reported as computed, with the difference stated in the change record, and the C1 sentence then carries the computed values. Nothing is re-run to move a value. New numbers enter the registry, which then goes to the author gate for a separate approval.
